caption: The drawing depicts a wooden mallet with a broad, rectangular head and a rounded handle extending downward. The mallet is colored in various shades of brown and tan, with darker lines suggesting wood grain and texture throughout the head and handle. On the top face of the mallet's head, there is an inscription that reads "H G" in ornate black lettering, as well as the date "1866" written below in a simpler style. The composition of the drawing is centered, with the mallet positioned upright against a plain, light beige background. The view is from above, showing the top and part of the side of the mallet's head and the full handle.
title: Bung Starter Mallet
